_comment: Static weekly WhatsApp reminders, sent by the `foe-reminders` GitHub Actions workflow (see .github/workflows/foe-reminders.yml) — independent of any guild officer's PC. anchor_date is the first occurrence (Prague-local); every_days is the repeat interval (7 = weekly, 14 = every two weeks). Edit text/anchor_date/every_days freely; the <...> placeholder in ki-tuesday's text is a Google Sheet link that still needs filling in.
